context: This evaluation assesses how well the engineer uses the vscode and vscode-languageclient package APIs to implement a VS Code extension with custom LSP requests and text decorations, focusing on correct usage of RequestType, LanguageClient, TextEditorDecorationType, and position/range conversion patterns from these packages.

checklist.name: Custom RequestType Definition
checklist.description: Uses RequestType from 'vscode-languageclient/node' to define HookDecorationsRequest.type with correct generic parameters (HookDecorationsParams, HookDecorationsResponse | null, void) and the request identifier 'react/hookDecorations'

checklist.name: LanguageClient Request Sending
checklist.description: Uses LanguageClient.sendRequest() method with the custom request type and HookDecorationsParams to send the LSP request and handle the Promise response

checklist.name: TextEditorDecorationType Creation
checklist.description: Uses vscode.window.createTextEditorDecorationType() to create a decoration type with borderWidth, borderStyle, and borderColor properties, specifically using vscode.ThemeColor('diffEditor.move.border')

checklist.name: Decoration Application
checklist.description: Uses TextEditor.setDecorations() method on vscode.window.activeTextEditor to apply decorations with an array of decoration options containing range and hoverMessage properties

checklist.name: Position Conversion
checklist.description: Converts Position literals {line, character} to vscode.Position objects using the vscode.Position constructor with line and character parameters

checklist.name: Range Conversion
checklist.description: Converts Position tuple [Position, Position] to vscode.Range objects using the vscode.Range constructor with start and end vscode.Position parameters
